name: binary_closure_auditor_ob3ect

phase_0.boundary_condition: The file's own end (EOF) and the closure identity fuse(parse(x))==x at every offset the format claims — nothing outside the file is trusted; the audit closes exactly where the file's own claims stop.

VINIT.chosen_element: raw input bytes before the container magic is read
VINIT.justification: void: nothing is named yet, the bytes are untyped

TANCH.chosen_element: the file boundary (EOF) that contains the whole audit
TANCH.justification: terminal anchor: every declared offset is checked against this single closed boundary

AFWD.chosen_element: forward parse from a declared offset to its content region
AFWD.justification: forward morphism: header field -> table -> entry, one directed transformation toward the claimed region

AREV.chosen_element: reverse walk of an offset/pointer chain back to its claim, held one frame up so it survives
AREV.justification: contravariant descent: following a pointer backwards and the cycle check that re-enters a strand state (CWE-835); the banked result survives because the holding frame is already open

CLINK.chosen_element: composition of the parse chain: header -> section/segment tables -> entries -> string/symbol/dynamic tables
CLINK.justification: sequential chaining of morphisms builds the full parse from the file's own claims

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: the audit of an audit: the object verifying its own verdict output round-trips
IMSCRIB.justification: identity/self-reference: audit(audit(x)) == audit(x), no finding on clean output, findings preserved on finding output

FSPLIT.chosen_element: the audit frame split: the raw file branches into its declared-structure claims and the verification result, inside a holding frame opened first
FSPLIT.justification: co-multiplication: one raw file branches into claims-to-audit and the audit's own verdict output

FFUSE.chosen_element: the closure check fuse(parse(x))==x that returns the raw file exactly as it was
FFUSE.justification: multiplication: the evaluated branches reunite into the exact input bytes the audit received — the file is unchanged, μ∘δ=id on the file itself

EVALT.chosen_element: the T-arm: closure holds at this offset — control, no finding
EVALT.justification: affirmative evaluation: the file agrees with itself

EVALF.chosen_element: the F-arm: closure fails — confirmed anomaly with evidence chain (CWE-125/190/754/787)
EVALF.justification: negative evaluation: the file disagrees with its own claim

ENGAGR.chosen_element: the dialetheic B cell: anomaly present but exploitability contested (class/entry-size disagreement, overlapping regions, generic heuristics)
ENGAGR.justification: both simultaneously: present on the observation lattice, contested on the finding lattice — held without resolution, flagged for triage

IFIX.chosen_element: the report: findings, evidence chains, verdicts — appended, irreversible
IFIX.justification: ROM fixation: the audit record is written once and never undone

phase_2.split_element: the audit frame over the file's own declared structure
phase_2.split_input: the raw binary file x, unchanged
split_outputs: the audit verdict output (T/F/B cells per claim)
the raw binary file x, unchanged
phase_2.fuse_element: the closure check that returns the file exactly as it was
phase_2.fuse_result: the raw binary file x, unchanged

phase_3.void_description: uninitialized bytes before the container magic identifies the lane (00)
phase_3.true_description: closure holds: the claim is inside bounds and consistent (01)
phase_3.false_description: closure fails: confirmed anomaly with evidence chain (10)
phase_3.both_description: dialetheic B: anomaly present, exploitability contested (11)

steps.domain_action: the raw binary file x enters — void bytes before any structure is named
open the holding frame — the audit frame that will hold the result is opened BEFORE the computing frame, so the fused file is banked when the reversal comes
detect the container magic (ELF/PE/Mach-O/generic) and forward into the matching lane
open the computing frame — split every declared claim into the T-arm (inside bounds, consistent) and the F-arm (violates closure)
evaluate the T-arm — closure holds at this offset, control, no finding
evaluate the F-arm — closure fails, confirmed anomaly with evidence chain
hold the dialetheic B cells without resolution — anomaly present, exploitability contested
close the computing frame — the evaluated claims fold back into the raw file, fuse(parse(x)) == x at every claim
audit the audit — the verdict output must round-trip (no finding on clean output, findings preserved on finding output)
reverse-walk the offset/pointer chains to confirm no cycle re-enters a strand state (CWE-835) — the banked result is held one frame up and survives
close the holding frame — the audit returns the raw file exactly as it was, μ∘δ=id on the file itself
write the report — findings, evidence chains, verdicts, appended irreversibly
terminate at the file boundary — the audit closes and contains the whole system

phase_5.compiler_frontend: binary_closure_parser.py — translates the file's own headers and tables into audit operations
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: the audit finding list: each cell (cell name, B4 verdict, CWE, severity, evidence chain) passed between lanes
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the parsed sections/segments/dynamic entries lists held as the file's declared-state registers
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the lane dispatch order: ident/magic -> header -> tables -> strings -> symbols -> dynamic -> pointer chains
phase_5.alfs_store: binary_testbed.py planted corpus + the 12/12 live binary corpus — the canonical ground-truth store

phase_6.cycle_cost: one audit pass over the file's declared structure per cycle (read-only)
phase_6.post_cycle_state: the same bytes with a verified verdict per claim and an appended report
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — nothing is written into the file, no state is changed, only the report record is appended outside it

banked_count_check.verdict: 4 unit(s) survived a clear by being banked in a frame (1 live clear(s))

rotat_audit.verdict: PHASE-BEARING — moves under ROTAT: closed_walk, final_register
